mainEntity.name: How can I track my progress in cardio endurance training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tracking your progress in cardio endurance training can be done through various metrics, such as improved workout times, increased distances covered, sustained heart rate zones, or reduced recovery time between efforts. At Cave Training, our coaches can help you identify key performance indicators specific to your goals and utilize consistent benchmarks. We often incorporate timed challenges or specific workout repetitions, allowing you to monitor tangible improvements in your stamina and overall fitness over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track progress by monitoring workout times, distances, heart rate zones, or recovery times. Cave Training coaches help identify KPIs and use benchmarks for measurable improvements.
